meta.name: add-codex
meta.description: Use Codex (OpenAI's codex app-server) as a full agent provider — planning, tool orchestration, MCP tools, server-side history, session resume — alongside or instead of Claude. ChatGPT subscription or OpenAI API key, vault-only via OneCLI. Per-group via `ncl groups config update --provider codex`. Distinct from using OpenAI as an MCP tool (where Claude remains the planner).

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 将 Codex 设为主智能体,接替 Claude 做规划、调用工具并恢复历史会话。
copy.fit_line: 适合你,如果希望终端 AI 的规划与工具调度由 Codex 接管。
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you want Codex to lead planning and tool calls in your terminal instead of Claude.

howto.what: 装上后,它把某个组的 agent 后端换成 Codex(OpenAI 的 codex app-server):由 Codex 负责规划、编排工具、调用 MCP 工具,会话历史存在服务端,可用线程 ID 续聊。凭据只存 OneCLI vault。
howto.when: 当你用 ncl groups config update --provider codex 把某个组切到 codex 时接管;也可把新组默认 provider 设为 codex。

say.text: 把这个组切到 codex 后端并重启
跑一遍 codex 的 provider 认证,用 ChatGPT 订阅登录
把新组的默认 agent provider 改成 codex

howto.what_en: Installs Codex (OpenAI's codex app-server) as a full agent backend for a group: planning, tool orchestration, MCP tools, server-side history, session resume. Credentials stay vault-only in OneCLI.
howto.when_en: Takes over when an operator runs `ncl groups config update --provider codex` for a group, or sets DEFAULT_AGENT_PROVIDER=codex for new groups.

say_en.text: Switch this group to the codex provider and restart it
say_en.note: Runs ncl groups config update, then restart

say_en.text: Run the codex provider auth step with my ChatGPT subscription
say_en.note: Lands the secret in the OneCLI vault

say_en.text: Make codex the default provider for new groups
